API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPolicy ManagementGets the rule in a policy for the specified ID.
Gets the rule in a policy for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/:policySetId/rule/:ruleId

Gets the rule in a policy for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

policySetId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the policy set.

ruleId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of a rule in a policy.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. Default value is 0 and get data from Default microtenant.

Default value: 0
